doc.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996

title: The hit 'Ain't Nobody's Business'
summary: He says the big hit was 'Ain't Nobody's Business', recorded in 1949, not with McShann.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Tell me about your hits you had with Jay McShann. Were these songs that —
I didn’t have no hits that he recorded with me. “Ain’t Nobody’s Business,” that was a big one.
Yeah. It’s right on here. Will you sign that for us before you leave?
You did that song in forty—
‘49. And did it get a lot of airplay at that time?
